title: Symbol on the Extra Tape
statement: Let $s$ and $a$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and choose a clock phase, an input-head position, tape contents and head positions for the $s$ yardstick tapes, the $a$ attempt tapes, and the extra tape, together with an output word. The symbol read by the head on the extra tape in the resulting host configuration is the content of that tape at its chosen head position.
hypotheses_covered: Contents and head positions for all s yardstick tapes
Contents and head positions for all a attempt tapes
Contents and head position for the extra tape
